The test spawns a real child process running the CLI through tsx; under full-suite parallel load it appears to miss its 20s window. None of this slice's changes touch src/cli.ts, the preview command, or how it spawns — every new test this slice added (in test/adapter.test.ts, test/generic.test.ts, test/preview.test.ts) passed in both full runs.
